brief:
The Guardian editorial argues that Britain can no longer ignore Israeli settlements and should stop helping to sustain them economically. The piece contends that international law, European action, and UK public opinion converge on the same conclusion. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband appeared to accept the principle underlying this position during parliamentary debate this week, according to the editorial.

The editorial maintains that Britain's current economic support for settlements contradicts the government's stated policy position and violates international legal obligations. The argument draws on three separate grounds—legal precedent, diplomatic alignments across Europe, and domestic public opinion—to make the case for a fundamental shift in how Britain approaches the issue.
